key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:7:0080
name: forward_to_library_routine
description: Calls one other library routine and then returns to its caller, passing the call straight through without any other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:7:0092
name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies a zero-terminated string from the source pointer into the destination buffer, then fills the rest of the counted buffer with zero bytes. It stops early if the count runs out before the terminator.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:10:0000
name: initialize_self_linked_node
description: Stores the address of its argument into the argument's first word, adds four to it, clears the second word and writes the original pointer into the third word. This sets up a node that points back to itself.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:0000
name: validate_then_process_entry
description: Returns success immediately when its pointer argument is null. Otherwise it calls a helper with a 20-byte request and, if that succeeds, calls two further helpers, the last using a pointer stored at offset 10 of the argument.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:0082
name: walk_linked_record_chain
description: Walks a chain of records by following the link at offset 12 of each one. For every record it runs two helper calls, the second sized from a count byte at offset 7, and returns 1 at the end of the chain or 0 if any step fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:00E2
name: return_success_flag
description: Returns the constant 1 to the caller with no other effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:00E6
name: pack_square_attributes_type6_files
description: Packs one byte per square into the 64-entry board table. For piece type 6 it uses class 3 on the first four files and class 7 on the rest.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:00EE
name: pack_square_attributes_previous_type
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, using the previous square's piece type to choose the class value for the next square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:01BC
name: pack_square_attributes_row_shortcut
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, choosing class values from piece type and colour bit and taking a shortcut at the start of each row.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:01C4
name: pack_square_attributes_colour_halves
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, choosing class values from the colour bit and whether the file is in the first four.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:020E
name: pack_square_piece_class_table
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, choosing class values from piece type and colour bit across several branches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:0298
name: pack_square_attributes_early_exit
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, choosing class values from piece type and colour bit with an early exit when the file is in the first four.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Icon.Library:3:029C
name: pack_square_attributes_full_classes
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, choosing class values 0 to 7 from piece type, colour bit and file.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:EndCLI:0:0136
name: pack_square_attributes_carry_flag
description: Packs one byte per square into the board table, carrying a colour flag from the previous square into the next byte.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0000
name: store_piece_type_bytes_only
description: Writes a byte per square into the 64-entry board table, carrying the piece-type value from one square to the next, with class values chosen from piece type and colour bit.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0004
name: initialize_credits_then_delay
description: Opens a library through a helper, makes seven setup calls on the global block and waits 250 ticks through the delay wrapper. It then sets a flag word at offset 206 of the opened object and calls a final routine with it; the strings it references are a greetings and thanks credit list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:021A
name: return_to_caller_unchanged
description: Returns immediately to the caller and leaves all registers and memory as they were.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0222
name: allocate_and_open_dos_stream
description: Allocates a block of six bytes per entry, fills in its header fields and returns early if the allocation fails. Otherwise it opens the file through the dos wrappers, stores the handle in the record and calls a further routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:035E
name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Copies a command string into a new buffer, splits it into space-separated words (quoted words may contain doubled quote characters) and builds a null-terminated array of pointers to the words. The array is left empty if the buffer cannot be allocated.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0532
name: append_string_bounded
description: Appends the source string to the end of the destination string, copying at most 32767 characters and terminating the result. It returns the destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:053A
name: append_counted_bytes_to_string
description: Finds the terminating zero of the destination string, then copies source bytes after it for up to the given count. It writes a terminator if the source ends early and returns the original destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:055E
name: copy_counted_bytes_zero_fill
description: Copies bytes from the source into the destination until a zero byte or the count runs out. It then fills the remaining positions with zero bytes and returns the original destination pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0580
name: resolve_icon_library_entry
description: Opens a library by name and looks up a named object through several library calls, storing the found object and a related pointer into the caller's record. Its referenced text names a window and the icon library.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0632
name: forward_varargs_to_formatter
description: Passes its single argument, together with the address of its variable argument list on the stack, to a formatting routine. It does no formatting of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0634
name: forward_formatter_arg_via_stack
description: Hands one argument and the stack address of the caller's argument list to a second routine. It is a thin wrapper that only forwards the call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0650
name: format_integer_digits_backward
description: Writes an integer's decimal digits from the end of a buffer toward its start, taking remainders and looking each digit up in a table. It prepends a minus sign for negative values and returns the start of the text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:06D6
name: format_arguments_into_stream
description: Walks a format string, sending plain characters to a callback and expanding each percent conversion with its optional width, precision and padding flags. Conversions cover characters, strings and integers in decimal, octal and hex. It returns the count of characters written, or -1 if the callback fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A3A
name: perform_signed_division
description: Works out the result sign from the signs of its two operands and calls a helper to do the division. It negates the quotient when the signs differ and returns it combined with the second operand as one 64-bit value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A7C
name: call_and_return_register_pair
description: Calls a helper and returns a 64-bit value built from the second input register as it stood before the call and the value the helper left in that register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A88
name: chain_call_and_return
description: Calls one other routine and returns to its caller without doing anything else.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0A92
name: divide_32bit_with_remainder
description: Divides a 32-bit dividend by a 32-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder together in one 64-bit value. Large divisors use a 16-step shift-and-subtract loop, while small divisors use direct division and modulo of 16-bit halves.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AE2
name: forward_with_base_pointer
description: Passes its argument and a pointer computed from the program's base register to a helper routine. It returns nothing itself.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0AF8
name: write_char_flush_on_newline
description: Passes a character and its stream record to a writer. For a newline on a stream with a particular flag bit set, it also calls a second routine with the stream and minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3C
name: return_immediately_no_op
description: Does nothing and returns to the caller at once.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B3E
name: store_byte_or_overflow
description: Appends one byte to a bounded buffer by storing it at the write pointer and advancing that pointer while space remains. When the buffer is full it hands the byte to a second routine and returns that routine's result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B6A
name: store_state_byte_and_advance
description: Writes the byte held at offset 11 of a state record into the buffer the pointer refers to, then advances the pointer by one. It returns the byte it wrote.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0B80
name: iterate_records_in_range
description: Steps through a range of 22-byte records from a base-relative start address up to an end address. It calls a helper once for each record it reaches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BA8
name: free_record_fields_and_clear
description: Calls helpers for each resource its flag bits mark, then clears the record's link fields and flag byte. It returns -1 for a null record and otherwise the combined result of the helper calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0BC4
name: clear_record_flagged_resources
description: Calls helpers for each resource the record's flag bits mark, then zeroes its link fields and flag byte. It returns the combined result of the helper calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C2E
name: write_byte_into_buffered_stream
description: Adds one byte to a buffer record and returns -1 when the error flag is already set. When the buffer is full it passes control to helpers, otherwise it writes the byte at the write position and returns it, setting the error flag if the write cannot be completed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C54
name: write_byte_or_close_buffer
description: When the count field is minus one, it closes the buffer and returns 0. Otherwise it stores the byte in the record's buffer and returns it, or returns -1 and sets the error flag if the write fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0C90
name: write_byte_unbuffered_or_close
description: Stores one byte into a buffer record, or finishes the buffer when its count field is minus one. In unbuffered mode it writes through a helper and sets the error flag when that helper fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CAA
name: write_byte_or_set_error
description: Writes one byte to a buffer record, first allocating its buffer through a helper if none exists. In single-byte mode it writes through a helper and sets the error flag on failure, otherwise it stores the byte directly.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0CF0
name: store_byte_into_record_buffer
description: Sets the buffered flag on a record, then stores one byte at its write position and advances that position. It returns the byte it stored.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D20
name: find_free_record_slot
description: Scans a table of 22-byte records for one whose flag byte is clear. It zeroes that record's link fields and returns it, or null when the table is full.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D48
name: find_free_record_in_table
description: Walks a 22-byte record table from the current pointer and clears the link fields of the first unused entry. It returns that entry, or null when no entry is free.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D4A
name: clear_record_link_fields
description: Zeroes the three link words at the start of the record it is given.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D58
name: allocate_record_buffer_or_inline
description: Tries to allocate a 1024-byte buffer for the record, recording its size and pointer and setting the buffered flag. If the allocation fails it falls back to a one-byte buffer inside the record, and it sets a further flag when a helper call succeeds.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0D8A
name: set_buffer_size_and_flags
description: Sets a record's buffer size to 1024 and marks it as buffered using the buffer pointer from a fixed global slot. It sets another flag when a helper call returns nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DB8
name: release_entries_in_list_order
description: Walks a linked list of entries, passing each entry and its size field plus eight to a helper routine. It then clears the list head and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DC6
name: free_linked_entries_in_order
description: Walks a linked list of entries, calling a helper with each entry and its size field plus eight. It clears the global list head once the walk is finished and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0DEA
name: allocate_node_into_list_head
description: Allocates a list node sized for the requested data plus eight bytes of header and links it at the head of the list. It returns a pointer just past the header, or null if the allocation fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E16
name: push_node_onto_list_head
description: Links a node at the head of the list, storing the caller's size value in it, and returns a pointer just past its header. It performs no allocation.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E2A
name: forward_argument_then_return
description: Passes its single argument straight to a helper routine and returns to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E3A
name: remove_matching_list_node
description: Searches the list for the node whose data pointer matches the argument, unlinks it and passes it to a helper with its size field. It returns 0 when a match is found and -1 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E4A
name: unlink_node_by_data_pointer
description: Searches the list for the node whose data pointer matches the argument, unlinks it and passes it to a helper with its size field. It returns 0 on success and -1 when no node matches.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E66
name: unlink_node_after_predecessor
description: Removes the node that follows the predecessor by linking the predecessor past it, or updating the list head when there is no predecessor. It then passes the removed node to a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E6E
name: advance_list_head_past_node
description: Sets the list head to the node's next link and passes the node to a helper routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0E86
name: check_indexed_entry_active
description: Checks an index against the table size and sets error code 2 with a return of -1 when it is out of range or the slot is empty. Otherwise it passes the slot's entry to a helper and returns 1 if that helper succeeds, or 0 if not.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0EC4
name: check_stream_is_interactive
description: Looks up a handle in a global table and passes it to the dos IsInteractive wrapper. It returns true when the stream is interactive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0EE4
name: return_zero_status
description: Returns the constant 0 to the caller with no other effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0EE8
name: delete_file_and_record_error
description: Calls the dos DeleteFile wrapper with its argument and returns 0 on success. On failure it stores the dos error code in a global slot and returns -1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F08
name: report_success_without_work
description: Returns 0 to its caller and performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F0C
name: dispatch_indexed_entry_operation
description: Validates an index into the slot table, setting error code 2 for a bad index or empty slot. It rejects entries lacking either of their two low mode bits with error code 5, and otherwise passes the entry to a helper and records an error code if that helper fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F4E
name: dispatch_entry_with_mode_check
description: Checks that the record has one of its two low mode bits set, setting error code 5 and returning -1 when neither is set. Otherwise it passes the record and two caller arguments to a helper and records an error code if that helper fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F64
name: write_entry_and_record_error
description: Passes an entry and two caller arguments to a write routine. On failure it stores the dos error code from the error wrapper in a global slot and returns -1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F8C
name: end_routine_without_effect
description: Returns to the caller immediately without any effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0F90
name: test_flag_and_report_status
description: Calls a library routine with a mask and tests bit 12 of the result. When that bit is set and a global flag is non-zero, it runs a helper and returns the result; otherwise it returns 0.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0FB8
name: run_helper_then_succeed
description: Calls a helper routine and then returns 0 to its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0FC0
name: fetch_output_stream_and_write
description: Gets the output stream through the dos wrapper and passes it to a write helper. It then makes a second helper call with the constant one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:0FEA
name: invoke_optional_hook_then_forward
description: Calls a hook routine stored in a global slot when one is set, then passes its argument on to a second routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:1008
name: release_program_resources
description: Tears down program resources: it releases each entry of the slot table and then the table itself, runs an optional exit hook and frees further held resources. It releases a file lock when one was taken and returns a value saved on the stack.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:111E
name: close_slot_and_clear
description: Validates a slot index and closes the file in that slot through the dos Close wrapper, unless the slot's high flag bit is set. It then clears the slot and returns 0, or sets error code 2 and returns -1 for a bad index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:1174
name: multiply_low_32_bits
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using the products of their 16-bit halves and keeps only the low 32 bits of the product. It returns that result in the high longword of a 64-bit value, with the second operand in the low longword.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:1230
name: invoke_library_entry_offset_414
description: Calls a function through a library jump table entry at offset minus 414, using the library base stored in a fixed global slot. It takes no arguments of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:1240
name: invoke_library_entry_offset_198
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 198 from the library base stored in a fixed global slot. It takes no arguments of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:1262
name: invoke_library_entry_offset_210
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 210 from the library base stored in a fixed global slot. It takes no arguments of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Chesstodh0:0:127E
name: invoke_library_entry_offset_552
description: Calls a library function at offset minus 552 from the library base stored in a fixed global slot. It takes no arguments of its own.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0000
name: startup_zero_globals_and_run
description: Program entry point: it zeroes a block of 8524 longwords of program globals and saves the system base pointer. It calls a handler if a flag bit is set, runs an initialisation routine, and calls a fallback routine when that routine returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0006
name: check_available_memory_then_loop
description: Makes a series of library calls while tracking progress in a counter. It compares a value from one call, offset by 14000, against 250000 and calls a routine with 14796 when the value is below that limit; its referenced text is a not-enough-memory message. It then loops indefinitely.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:00DE
name: process_board_input_messages
description: Handles pending input messages for the 8-by-8 chessboard, tracking the selected square and cursor cell and returning a status code. Its referenced text is a 'boards are not synchronized' message. The code is truncated in the input, so later branches are only partly visible.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0684
name: refresh_board_display_stages
description: Runs a sequence of display helpers, each gated on a progress counter, and calls an update routine with two position values once the counter passes two. It ends with a final helper call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0686
name: run_board_update_stages
description: Repeats the same staged display sequence as its neighbour, calling each display helper only when the progress counter reaches its threshold. It finishes with a helper call that does not depend on the counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:06F6
name: take_pending_move_buffer
description: Checks a pending-move flag and, when it is set, calls a helper, clears the flag and returns a pointer to a fixed move buffer. It returns zero when no move is pending.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0716
name: return_null_result
description: Returns 0 to its caller with no other effect.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:071A
name: build_square_attribute_table
description: Fills a 64-entry table with one packed byte per board square, combining the piece type, a colour class and an empty-square flag. Board indices are mapped through an offset layout with 16 cells per row, and helper calls run before and after the scan.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0770
name: pack_square_attributes_file_class
description: Repeats the square attribute scan, choosing the colour class from the square's file position. It writes the packed bytes into the same 64-entry board table and returns after the last square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0774
name: pack_square_attributes_pawn_class
description: Packs a byte for each of the 64 squares in the same board scan, using a pawn-specific class value. It writes results into the 64-entry board table and returns after the last square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:079A
name: pack_square_attributes_row_steps
description: Packs per-square attribute bytes in the same scan, stepping through the board in row-sized runs and skipping a run of four files at each row edge. It writes into the 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:07A0
name: pack_square_attributes_edge_class
description: Packs attribute bytes for the 64 squares, assigning the class value by whether the square lies on an edge file. It writes results into the same 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:07B4
name: pack_square_attributes_row_class
description: Packs attribute bytes for the 64 squares, assigning the class value by the square's row. It writes results into the same 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:07BA
name: pack_square_attributes_knight_class
description: Packs attribute bytes for the 64 squares with a knight-specific class value, using the same board scan. It writes results into the 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:07CE
name: pack_square_attributes_slider_class
description: Packs attribute bytes for the 64 squares with class values chosen for sliding pieces, using the same board scan. It writes results into the 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:07E6
name: pack_square_attributes_flag_carry
description: Packs attribute bytes for the 64 squares, carrying a colour flag from the previous square into each byte. It writes results into the 64-entry board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0800
name: clear_square_attribute_table
description: Writes a zero-class byte for each of the 64 squares in the board table and then returns. It performs no piece lookups.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0820
name: build_row_occupancy_masks
description: Builds eight row bitmasks from the 64-entry board table, setting a row's bit for each occupied square whose colour bit matches the argument. It clears each row mask before filling it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0898
name: clear_selection_slots
description: Resets two selection slots to 255, which marks them empty. When the first slot holds a value it first calls helpers to release it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:08D6
name: setup_board_buffers_run_loop
description: Points five screen buffer pointers at consecutive 8000-byte blocks, clears an eight-entry selection table to 255 and copies a 480-byte table into place. It then runs the board event loop, dispatching input codes to handlers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0AA8
name: copy_board_table_process_events
description: Copies 480 bytes from a source table into a work area, then runs the same input-code dispatcher as its neighbours. The dispatcher includes a reset branch that clears the 64-square board table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0ADC
name: dispatch_board_event_codes
description: Handles the square under the cursor by selecting or placing a piece and updating the occupancy and colour tables, then waits for input and dispatches the codes it receives. A reset code clears the 64-square board table and a restore code copies the saved board back into the work area.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0BAA
name: run_board_input_until_exit
description: Runs the square input loop, selecting or placing pieces and dispatching input codes, until a setup code succeeds, and then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0BD8
name: resume_board_loop_after_clear
description: Clears the pending piece state and the selected-square fields, then re-enters the board event dispatcher without copying any table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0C40
name: select_piece_slot_and_dispatch
description: Checks the pending piece state, then searches the 32 piece slots for the first free entry. When none is free it reports failure, and otherwise it enters the board event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0CA0
name: dispatch_board_events_slot_search
description: Searches the 32-entry piece table for a free slot and runs the board event dispatcher, reporting a full table when none is free.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0CD2
name: place_piece_report_full_table
description: Searches the 32-entry piece table from the current index for an empty slot. When none is free it calls a message routine with the text 'Too many pieces.', otherwise it places the piece and runs the event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0D00
name: place_piece_slot_dispatch
description: Records the current index, places the pending piece on the chosen square and runs the board event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0D46
name: clear_board_then_dispatch_events
description: Clears the 64-entry board table and its paired work table, then runs the board event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0D84
name: restore_saved_board_and_dispatch
description: Copies 480 bytes from the saved board into the work area, resets the pending piece state and runs the board event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0D94
name: copy_board_bytes_then_dispatch
description: Copies bytes from the saved board into the work area one at a time until 480 are written, then runs the board event dispatcher.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0DBA
name: handle_pending_commands_then_dispatch
description: While a poll routine returns a non-zero command, it handles that command and runs the board event dispatcher. It returns once no command is pending.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0DD2
name: initialise_game_state_from_setup
description: Resets the selection and pointer state, copies two setup values from the caller's frame into the game fields, runs setup helpers and clears the busy flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0E1A
name: run_board_event_loop_forever
description: Runs the board event dispatcher in an endless loop, with no exit path inside this routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0E1C
name: process_next_board_event
description: Waits for the next input code and processes it, selecting or placing pieces for the square-selection code. It returns once the terminal branch completes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0E5A
name: relay_single_argument_call
description: Passes its single argument to another routine and returns to the caller without further work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0E76
name: invoke_handler_then_return
description: Calls a handler stored in a global slot, passing its argument, then calls one more routine and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0E92
name: map_click_to_board_square
description: Converts a screen click into a board square by finding its column and row in two nine-entry boundary tables. A click off the grid resets the selection, a click on the same square toggles a highlight flag, and any other square is recorded as the new selection.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:0FC6
name: clear_selection_and_pending_state
description: Stores the current selection and target fields, sets both selection markers to 255 and redraws the pending piece when one exists. It then clears the move and piece flags.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1032
name: restore_selection_from_saved
description: Copies a saved selection byte into the current selection marker, calls a helper with the constant 28, and restores three saved flag bytes into the move fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1070
name: read_text_input_line
description: Reads keystrokes into a text buffer with an underscore cursor, appending printable characters up to a maximum length and deleting the last character on backspace. It stops at return, null-terminates the buffer and returns the final length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:117C
name: prompt_for_thinking_minutes
description: Displays the prompt 'Number of minutes to think:' and reads a numeric entry by converting its digits into a number. It repeats until the value is between 1 and 10000 and returns it, or zero for a negative result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:11F8
name: read_numeric_entry_until_valid
description: Reads a numeric entry digit by digit, re-prompting until the value is non-zero and below 10001. It then clears the prompt and returns the value, or zero if negative.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:123E
name: read_numeric_entry_retry_loop
description: Repeatedly shows an input prompt and reads digits until a non-zero value below 10001 is entered. It clears the prompt and returns that value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1278
name: return_void_no_op
description: Returns immediately and does nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1294
name: show_message_until_button_press
description: Draws a centred message box sized to the message text with a minimum width of 26 characters. It shows the message with '=Left Button= to continue.' and waits for the matching input code before clearing the box.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:13A2
name: wait_for_remote_board_sync
description: When either of two state words equals 2, it passes a fixed four-byte signature to a helper and polls input until the sync flag clears. It then resets the sync state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:140E
name: clear_pending_input_flags
description: Clears a pending-input word and a byte flag in the global block, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:141A
name: read_typed_command_line
description: Reads a typed entry of up to 40 characters, ends it with a carriage return and passes the text to a handler. A triple-plus entry takes the same call as any other entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:14D0
name: send_fixed_command_string
description: Stores a fixed four-byte string ending in a carriage return and passes it to a text handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:14EE
name: report_opponent_quit_message
description: Passes the 'Your Opponent just quit' message from the global block to a text handler and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:151E
name: await_remote_choice_or_click
description: If the given player slot holds the value 2, it waits for a remote flag, takes it and returns it. Otherwise it draws a four-part panel, waits for a click inside a fixed rectangle, and returns the lookup-table entry for the clicked column.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1548
name: take_pending_remote_flag
description: Returns the byte in a global flag slot and clears the slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1558
name: select_option_by_click_region
description: Draws a four-part panel, waits for input inside a fixed rectangle, and returns the table entry for the clicked column.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1560
name: select_option_click_region_b
description: Repeats the panel-and-click routine of its neighbour, returning the table entry for the clicked column from the same four-entry table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:156E
name: prompt_pawn_promotion_choice
description: Displays the 'Promote pawn to?' panel and waits for a click inside a fixed rectangle. It returns the promotion choice for the clicked column from a lookup table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:16B0
name: wait_for_click_in_rectangle
description: Polls input until the pointer is inside a fixed rectangle, then sets the selection flag and returns the table entry for the clicked column.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1722
name: draw_nested_line_pattern
description: Sets the pen from its last argument and draws a shape from the first four arguments. It then draws three further shapes with their coordinates moved inward one step each, the pen counting down from 30.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:17D2
name: update_piece_style_if_changed
description: Compares the stored piece style byte with its argument and, when they differ, stores the new value and redraws the piece image from a table indexed by the style. The style value 4 uses different offsets.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:183E
name: lay_out_board_memory_regions
description: Partitions a large work block into regions: it stores pointers for four sized slots, a 40000-byte area and several fixed-size areas. It fills a table of 17 entries with computed offsets, then calls a helper and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1A20
name: set_two_panel_pointer_pairs
description: Stores two pointer pairs for panel data, where each second pointer lies 264 bytes after its first and a third pointer lies 60 bytes further on.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1A70
name: initialise_board_state_tables
description: Resets the selection sentinels and the six-entry and eight-entry state tables, loads graphics through helpers and points the table pointers at fixed data. A mode flag chooses one of two layouts.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1B46
name: load_board_layout_pointers
description: Loads graphics through helpers and sets five table pointers to fixed data regions, then calls a final helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1BCE
name: xor_scramble_board_buffer
description: Loads an image block through a helper, then XORs a 39960-byte region with the same region shifted forward 40 bytes, one byte at a time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1C3C
name: save_board_state_snapshot
description: Copies six state values and the current work pointer into a saved-state block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1C6E
name: restore_board_state_snapshot
description: Copies six saved state values and the work pointer back from the saved-state block into the live state.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1CA0
name: save_board_state_secondary
description: Copies the same six state values and work pointer as its neighbour into a second saved-state block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1CD2
name: empty_stub_return
description: Empty routine that returns to its caller immediately.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1D0C
name: blit_sprite_list_into_buffer
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of sprite records, storing each record's source pointer and destination offset. It copies each image into the work buffer with its size taken from width and height entries, then stores the advanced pointer and index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:1E60
name: build_sprite_index_table
description: Clears a 256-entry index table and walks the sprite records to fill it, calling helpers to set up the source data first. It stores the final work pointer and a count.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:21F6
name: update_sprite_slot_positions
description: Clears a slot's active flag and reloads its six positional entries, adjusting them by a stored step value. It then subtracts the slot's height difference from the running total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:22BC
name: update_sprite_list_entries_slot
description: Updates the entry list for the current slot by comparing and shifting its six positional values against saved ones. It then subtracts the slot's height difference from the running total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2412
name: encode_sprite_row_deltas
description: Copies sprite row words into a buffer, storing each row as a difference from the previous row's value and ending each row at a marker of minus one. It stores the end pointers when finished.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:243A
name: copy_sprite_slot_block
description: Adjusts a range of positional entries by a stored step, copies a block of words from one slot buffer to another, then subtracts the slot's height difference from the running total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:245E
name: undo_sprite_slot_adjustment
description: Removes a stored step from a range of positional entries, copies a block of words back into the slot buffer, and subtracts the slot's height difference from the running total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:24D6
name: subtract_slot_height_from_total
description: Subtracts the slot's height difference from the running total counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:24FE
name: register_sprite_slot
description: Marks a sprite slot active and stores its data pointers and height. It builds an index list of the slot's entries through a helper and records the buffer pointers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:25E6
name: load_sprite_slot_buffer
description: Marks a sprite slot as loaded and records the current work pointer. It calls a loader for the slot's data, then advances the work pointer by the aligned size returned by a helper and stores the new end pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2654
name: compose_sprite_frame_list
description: Computes the free buffer space from the total and the used region, and sums the sizes of active sprite slots. It copies each active slot's sprite data into the frame list through helpers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2766
name: allocate_sprite_slots_by_size
description: Marks sprite flags from a list of slot entries, then repeatedly picks the pending slot of smallest size and places it, reducing the free-space total, until no pending slot remains.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:27AE
name: place_pending_sprite_slots
description: Repeats the slot placement loop, choosing the pending slot of smallest size and reducing free space by its height difference. When no fit is possible it reports an error code through a message routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2844
name: retry_sprite_placement_low_memory
description: Loops over sprite placement and reports the 'error not enough memory' message when free space is below the requirement. It releases slots and retries until enough space is available.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2850
name: retry_sprite_placement_loop
description: Repeats sprite placement while free space is short, releasing active slots on each pass until enough space is available.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2870
name: place_selected_sprite_slot
description: Releases each inactive slot, then places a pending slot with its source and index data through helpers when the free-space condition holds, updating the free-space total.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2A3E
name: push_value_onto_pending_stack
description: Pushes a value onto a pending stack by decrementing a stack counter and storing the value in that slot. When the stack is empty it calls a helper instead, and its referenced text is 'error 104'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2A6E
name: pop_pending_value_or_fail
description: Stores a word into the current slot and returns the next pending value from a four-entry stack. When the stack is empty it calls a helper instead, and returns its input unchanged when a condition flag is set.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2A78
name: pop_pending_stack_value
description: Returns the next value from a four-entry pending stack and advances the stack index. When the stack is empty it calls a helper with the stack's failure callback.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2A9E
name: forward_error_103_report
description: Forwards a callback to a helper routine to report error 103, then returns. Its referenced text is 'error 103'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2AAA
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Stub made of bad instruction data rather than a working routine, so it has no meaningful behaviour to describe.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2AB4
name: push_value_or_report_full
description: Stores its argument on a pending stack when there is room, decrementing the stack index. Otherwise it calls a helper to report a full stack; its referenced text is 'error 102'.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2AE4
name: merge_sample_bytes_clamped
description: Combines pairs of source byte groups into four output bytes by comparing sample values and clamping sums. It also sets a global to 1024 and calls a routine; the decompiled code is truncated, so later branches are only partly visible.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2AEE
name: pop_pending_value_or_report
description: Returns the next value from a four-entry pending stack, or calls a helper to report error 101 when the stack is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2B20
name: blend_bytes_with_clamped_sum
description: Blends sample bytes with a clamped sum, choosing the result by comparing the third and fourth sample bytes. Part of the decoded code is bad data, so its tail is uncertain.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2B2A
name: wait_until_global_bit_clear
description: Loops until bit 6 of a global status word is clear, then returns. Its facts list the DMA control read register as touched.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2B3E
name: process_undecoded_routine
description: Decompiled pseudo-code is unavailable, so only its facts are known: four routines call it and it calls three others over 31 instructions. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2B94
name: combine_byte_pairs_clamped
description: Combines byte pairs from two source groups into one output group using clamped sums and comparisons, then sets a global to 1024 and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2BAA
name: combine_sample_pair_bytes
description: Combines two sample pairs byte by byte with clamped sums and comparisons, then sets a global to 1024 and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2BCC
name: select_sample_bytes_clamped
description: Selects the larger of two clamped sample sums for each byte of a four-byte group, then sets a global to 1024 and calls a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2C10
name: setup_blit_copy_parameters
description: Writes a fixed control sequence into a global register block, then computes source and destination offsets from two byte groups and calls a helper. It finishes by setting a global to 1024 and calling a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2C2A
name: setup_blit_masked_copy
description: Writes the same fixed control sequence as its neighbour, computing offsets from byte groups with a larger-of comparison before calling a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2C50
name: setup_blit_source_offsets
description: Writes a fixed control sequence to the global register block and computes source offsets from one byte group, then calls a helper and a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:2C6A
name: configure_blitter_dma_transfer
description: Programs the blitter first-word and last-word masks, pointers, modulo and size values, then enables DMA through the DMA control register with bit 15 set. The blit size is derived from the source and destination byte groups.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:304C
name: run_five_blit_row_copies
description: Programs the blitter for five consecutive rows with a fixed size value, taking the pointers from a table and enabling DMA through the DMA control register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3102
name: unlink_entry_from_list_head
description: Walks a linked list from a fixed head and, when it finds the given entry, replaces the link that points to it with that entry's next pointer. The next pointer is stored 28 bytes into the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3136
name: process_undecoded_routine_b
description: Decompiled pseudo-code is unavailable, so only its facts are known: two routines call it and it runs 27 instructions. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3182
name: forward_with_two_prior_calls
description: Makes two helper calls with no arguments, then passes its 16-bit argument to a third routine. Eighteen routines call it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:31C6
name: reset_entry_fields_after_calls
description: Calls helpers with the entry and with its word at offset 2, then zeroes the longword at offset 20 and the byte at offset 11 of the entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3200
name: drain_pending_list_head
description: Repeatedly passes the head entry of a global list to a helper until the list is empty.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3218
name: process_undecoded_routine_c
description: Decompiled pseudo-code is unavailable, so only its facts are known: two routines call it and it calls three others over 153 instructions. Its purpose cannot be determined from the evidence.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:33F0
name: configure_blit_rectangle
description: Converts a rectangle's coordinates into blitter width, height and size values. It reports error 01 when the area exceeds a limit, and otherwise programs the blitter registers and DMA control with a source pointer offset by 32000.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:356C
name: draw_overlapping_sprite_entries
description: Walks a linked list of sprite entries, keeps those whose rectangles overlap the clip area, and programs the blitter with their source, mask and destination pointers. It enables DMA through the DMA control register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3BF0
name: blit_multi_plane_block
description: Blits a block of bitplanes by programming the blitter with all-ones first and last word masks. Plane offsets come from the block's dimensions and a shared destination pointer, and DMA is enabled through the DMA control register.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3CF2
name: blit_block_three_planes
description: Blits a block using the same blitter programming pattern as its neighbour, with plane offsets at two, three and four times the row stride and a fixed source pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3DC8
name: store_sprite_entry_record
description: Fills a 32-byte sprite record with its coordinates and a bounding box computed from a source entry, plus a visibility byte and a link pointer, then calls a helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:3E82
name: build_menu_entry_records
description: Finds the longest string in a list of menu text entries, then fills in a 32-byte record for each entry and clears its link field, calling a helper for each.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:4392
name: draw_menu_rows_with_items
description: Draws a menu panel one row at a time from the bottom, placing each row's items at computed positions and drawing separators between them. It finishes the panel frame after the last row.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:4560
name: layout_menu_items
description: Lays out menu entries by measuring each string and assigning positions on a 16-unit step. It then stores the number of entries minus one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:46FA
name: read_selected_menu_value
description: Returns the value stored for the current menu selection when that item's flag is set, otherwise zero. It then clears the selection and redraws a status line.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:4782
name: set_menu_item_highlight
description: Stores the pointer for the chosen menu item and passes a highlight mode of 25 or 0, with the item's width, to a drawing helper.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:47DC
name: select_menu_column_under_pointer
description: Finds the menu column under the pointer from five boundary values and selects it when it differs from the current choice, clearing the previous highlight. It also updates the item under the pointer when the pointer is inside the menu panel.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:4914
name: draw_padded_menu_text
description: Copies a menu item's text into a 20-character buffer padded with spaces to a computed width. It then draws the text through a helper, with the highlight style chosen from the item's flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW].adf:Battlechess:0:49F8
name: toggle_menu_highlight_frame
description: Alternates a menu highlight between two frame pointers on each call and draws the chosen frame through a helper. It also steps a blink counter that sets a colour step while active.
